title: Zesty Vietnamese Tofu Sandwich
description: A winey, aerated banh-mi style sandwich with puff pastry, steamed tofu, and zesty pickled vegetables, perfect for a cozy lunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200C and bake the puff pastry sheet for 10 minutes until puffed and golden.
While the pastry bakes, marinate the tofu cubes in soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, and sesame oil for 10 minutes.
Steam the marinated tofu in a steamer basket for 8 minutes until heated through.
In a bowl combine the cucumber, carrot, pickled daikon, cilantro, and jalapeno to create a fresh slaw.
Slice the baked puff pastry into 2 equal halves and flatten each with a rolling pin.
Spread the slaw evenly over one half of the pastry, then top with the steamed tofu cubes.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, pressing gently to seal edges.
Serve the sandwich warm, optionally drizzling a little more soy sauce over top.
Serve immediately to enjoy the crisp pastry and zesty flavors.
